### 2026-10-19 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/YITT1BpIhaUfu2wESuCR2Vtd1HPsflo7/a8f13495af6ba0dcaaa158c5ec4181fccfbae0dc82e975a494e0932ecfb6f029.png)

**2h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/YITT1BpIhaUfu2wESuCR2Vtd1HPsflo7/a8f13495af6ba0dcaaa158c5ec4181fccfbae0dc82e975a494e0932ecfb6f029.png)
I did some major changes to my schematic including removing the Slide Potentiometer, adding the Slide Potentiometer back, then removing it again (because I have no space left on my MCU and also CANADIAN STUFF ARE SO EXPENSIVE and after some intense research, everywhere selling these needs 20 dollars shipping for some reason.
so, for the same reason, Rotary Encoder is also gone and now I have more key switches. I am in the trenches ;-;
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/YITT1BpIhaUfu2wESuCR2Vtd1HPsflo7/069b778f523bedb38f1840b39f7302440e3378fa5ca5ee2a82a66e346feecad5.png)

### 2026-10-19 – ![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/YITT1BpIhaUfu2wESuCR2Vtd1HPsflo7/eb8d3cae34a90053ee5e2bb0cc0bba16b0a71a602a58d37911398f050bdd2cfd.png) I spent a bit time comi

**2h**

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/YITT1BpIhaUfu2wESuCR2Vtd1HPsflo7/eb8d3cae34a90053ee5e2bb0cc0bba16b0a71a602a58d37911398f050bdd2cfd.png) I spent a bit time coming up with how the keypads should look like since I think piano keys look boring. I decided to make it look like a more standard controller layout, and the idea is that this way people who are not musicians can actually play it. Because if someone can play a piano they probably have access to one and wouldnt need a tiny MIDI piano.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/YITT1BpIhaUfu2wESuCR2Vtd1HPsflo7/6bbe8ceb382333da322afb7c3faae5b3485a93211d9328a1bd1614fa3bcdc1f7.png) the idea is that it can teach people music production so the 2 rows of LED can be the display of stats while the for main controls are selection, the middle is confirm and the two pads on the side are for effects such as eq/panning/reverb etc
